## The counterexample and its proof

Let \(V=\mathbb C^6\), write \(\mathbb P^5=\mathbb P(V)\), and let \(Q\) be the rank-\(5\) universal quotient:
\[
0\longrightarrow\mathcal O(-1)\longrightarrow V\otimes\mathcal O
\longrightarrow Q\longrightarrow0.
\]
Choose the full-rank bivector
\[
\omega=e_0\wedge e_1+e_2\wedge e_3+e_4\wedge e_5.
\]
Set \(B=\Lambda^2Q\) and
\[
0\longrightarrow\mathcal O\xrightarrow{\omega}B
\longrightarrow E_\omega\longrightarrow0.
\]

### Local freeness and uniformity

At a point \([\ell]\), the section is the projection of \(\omega\) to \(\Lambda^2(V/\ell)\). It cannot vanish: a bivector in \(\ell\wedge V\) has rank at most \(2\), whereas \(\omega\) has rank \(6\). Hence \(E_\omega\) is locally free of rank \(10-1=9<2\cdot5\).

For any line \(L=\mathbb P(U)\), \(\dim U=2\),
\[
Q|_L\simeq\mathcal O_L(1)\oplus\mathcal O_L^4,\qquad
B|_L\simeq\mathcal O_L(1)^4\oplus\mathcal O_L^6.
\]
The constant component of the section is its projection to \(\Lambda^2(V/U)\). If this vanished, then \(\omega\in U\wedge V\). But every such bivector has rank at most \(4\): choosing a basis \(u_1,u_2\) of \(U\), it has the form
\[
u_1\wedge v_1+u_2\wedge v_2.
\]
Thus the constant component is nonzero on every line. A bundle automorphism removes the positive-degree components of the section, giving
\[
E_\omega|_L\simeq\mathcal O_L(1)^4\oplus\mathcal O_L^5.
\]
This proves uniformity on **all** lines, not just general lines.

### Non-homogeneity

The proof recovers the projective bivector \([\omega]\) from \(E_\omega\).

First,
\[
H^0(B^*)=H^1(B^*)=0,\qquad B^*=\Omega^2(2).
\]
The exterior Euler sequence reduces this to exactness of
\[
0\longrightarrow\Lambda^2V^*
\longrightarrow V^*\otimes V^*
\longrightarrow\operatorname{Sym}^2V^*
\longrightarrow0.
\]
Applying \(\operatorname{Hom}(-,\mathcal O)\) to the defining sequence consequently gives
\[
\operatorname{Ext}^1(E_\omega,\mathcal O)\simeq\mathbb C.
\]
The defining extension is nonzero, since a splitting would provide a nonzero map \(B\to\mathcal O\).

\[
0\to Q(-1)\to\Lambda^2V\otimes\mathcal O\to B\to0

\[
